dedupe_keys.name: jrc mars agri4cast crop monitoring and yield forecasting data

description: AGRI4CAST is the Joint Research Centre's crop monitoring and yield forecasting activity, built on the MARS Crop Yield Forecasting System in support of the EU Common Agricultural Policy. Its website gathers the JRC MARS Atlas of agro-meteorological indicators for monitoring agricultural conditions across Europe in maps and graphs at several scales; the AGRI4CAST Resources Portal, which makes the system's datasets freely available for access and reuse; the monthly JRC MARS Bulletin with analyses of growing conditions and quantitative yield forecasts for major crops in the EU and neighbouring countries, with an archive of all bulletins since 2007; a system wiki; and explanatory videos. Coverage is Europe and neighbouring countries. Access is free; the reuse terms are on the resources portal and were not read. Caveats: forecasts are model and expert estimates that are revised through the season, and the data portal has its own dataset-specific conditions. For simulation it provides agro-meteorological indicators and crop yield forecasts for drought, heat and flood impact on European agriculture. Related catalogue records include the GEOGLAM Crop Monitor, JRC EUCROPMAP and PCSE and WOFOST.
